title: 第23章 先天戊己杏黄旗对战天道多宝塔第24章 无上异宝显威能戊己杏黄入塔中
slug: 洪荒我怎么变成混沌至宝了
content_zh:
截教这边一片其乐融融的气氛，反观阐教几人都面色难看！
文殊广法天尊眼睁睁的看着自己最珍贵的灵宝就这么没了，心如刀绞，本来还打算胡搅蛮缠一下，看看能不能留下法宝！
可惜元始天尊已经判定他输了此局，灵宝都送出去了，只能愤愤不平的作罢！
大殿之上，元始天尊低头轻轻算了算，发现卦象混乱，完全没有头绪！
可是之前在昆仑山玉虚宫内推算之时，卦象明明是大吉之象啊！
所以他才带着几位徒弟来碧游宫兴师问罪，可是为什么如今到了截教，却已经连输两件灵宝了？
通天教主观察到元始天尊的动作，抬头说道：
“师兄，最近天地间劫气翻涌，难道又要发生混乱了吗？”
元始天尊摇了摇头，掐指一算后淡淡说道：
“目前妖庭和巫族都在修身养息，暂时应该不会再大战了！”
通天教主叹了口气道：
“现在天道气息被大劫遮掩，即使是我们也受到了些许影响……”
元始天尊闻言点了点头，看着下方的淡淡开口道：
“的确！斗宝继续吧！”
而此时此刻，阐教仅剩装病的广成子和赤精子了！
两人面面相觑，都没有考虑好到底哪一个先上！
本来他们这一趟是来卖惨抢宝的，没想到变成现在这样！
阐截已经白白丢了两件灵宝了，这要是在输下去，这元始天尊的面皮怕是要丢光了！
赤精子看着对面的截教众人，灵机一动率先开口道：
“前两次都是我阐教先派人出战，而且连灵宝都展示出来了，现在该你们截教先上了！”

之前他们都以为势在必得，所以根本不在乎先后顺序！
但是已经连输两局了，他们俩哪里还有之前的自信呢！
谁知道这些截教中人会不会又莫名其妙拿出一件件厉害的灵宝，那还这么打？
碧霄可不惯着他们，直接开口怼道：
“你们抢着出战现在还怪上我们了？这斗宝还不是你们提出来的，现在怕是输不起怕了吧！哈哈哈哈……”
广成子和赤精子这次都面面相觑，没有反驳，但是就赖在蒲团之上不动！
明摆着一副你们不出人，我就不动的样子！
林镜早就通过宝光看到了他们两人身上所携带的灵宝到底是什么了，回过头便对着多宝道人说道：
“师兄，这第三场就由你上场吧！”
多宝道人闻言顿时兴奋了起来，撸起袖子就往前冲！
前面赵公明和龟灵圣母都赢了一件先天灵宝送给了师弟，多宝都有些担心师弟要被拐跑了！
现在终于轮到了他出场了，那这一局不管对面是什么先天灵宝，统统都得给我师弟交出来！
多宝道人直接来到那处空间面前站定，随即一道九层的晶莹宝塔出现在手中！
“截教多宝道人，携带多宝塔出站！”
一道流光闪过，他手中的晶莹宝塔已经落入了空间之中！
大殿之上，元始天尊露出了一丝疑惑的神情，多宝塔他在分宝崖见过，可是现在来看这气息似乎有些不同啊！
不过看着赤精子信心满满的站了出来，元始天尊倒是松了一口气！
就算这多宝塔变强了些许又如何，对上赤精子手中的灵宝也得落败
正好回头可以拿着多宝塔研究一下，看看这三弟的炼器手法到底有何玄妙！
眼见多宝道人率先出战，并且还亮出了对战灵宝多宝塔！

赤精子顿时来了精神，雄赳赳气昂昂的大步走到了中央！
“多宝师兄，赐教了！”
他的手掌轻轻一抬，一面二丈左右的黄色小旗缓缓浮现！
content_en:
There was a happy atmosphere here at Jie Jiao, but everyone in Chan Jiao looked ugly!
Manjusri Guangfa Tianzun watched helplessly as his most precious spiritual treasure was gone, and his heart was in a knife's edge. He originally planned to mess around with it to see if he could keep the magic treasure!
It's a pity that Yuanshi Tianzun has judged that he has lost this game, and all the spiritual treasures have been given away, so he can only give up angrily!
Above the main hall, Yuanshi Tianzun lowered his head and did some calculations, and found that the hexagrams were in chaos, with no clue at all!
But when I was doing calculations in the Yuxu Palace in Kunlun Mountain, the hexagrams were clearly auspicious!
That's why he brought several disciples to Biyou Palace to raise his master to question him. But why now that he has arrived at Jiejiao, he has already lost two spiritual treasures in a row?
Leader Tongtian observed the movements of Yuanshi Tianzun, raised his head and said:
"Senior brother, the calamity energy between heaven and earth has been surging recently. Is there going to be chaos again?"
Yuanshi Tianzun shook his head, counted his fingers and said lightly:
"Currently, both the Demon Court and the Witch Clan are cultivating themselves and recuperating, and there should be no more wars for the time being!"
Leader Tongtian sighed and said:
"Now that the aura of heaven has been obscured by the catastrophe, even we have been slightly affected..."
Yuanshi Tianzun nodded when he heard the words, looked down and said lightly:
"Indeed! Let's continue the treasure fight!"
At this moment, the only ones left in Chanjiao are Guang Chengzi and Chi Jingzi, who are pretending to be sick!
The two looked at each other, neither of them thinking about which one would go first!
Originally, they came here to sell misfortune and steal treasures, but they didn't expect it to turn out like this!
Chanjie has already lost two spiritual treasures in vain. If he continues to lose, Yuanshi Tianzun will probably lose all his dignity!
Chi Jingjing looked at the Jiejiao people on the opposite side and suddenly had an idea and spoke first:
"In the first two times, I, the Chanjiao, sent people to fight first, and even displayed the spiritual treasures. Now it's your turn, the Interceptorjiao, to go first!"
Before, they all thought they were bound to win, so they didn’t care about the order!
But they have lost two games in a row. How can they still have the confidence they had before?
Who knows if these Jie Cult members will inexplicably come up with powerful spiritual treasures one after another, so they still fight like this?
Bixiao didn't tolerate them, so he directly said:
"You rushed to fight and now you blame us? You didn't come up with this battle of treasures. Now I'm afraid you can't be afraid of losing! Hahahaha..."
Hironariko and Aka Seiko looked at each other this time and did not refute, but just stayed on the futon without moving!
It's obvious that if you don't leave anyone, I won't move!
Lin Jing had already seen through Baoguang what the spiritual treasures they were carrying were. He turned around and said to Taoist Duobao:
"Senior brother, it's up to you to play in this third game!"
Taoist Duobao suddenly became excited when he heard this, rolled up his sleeves and rushed forward!
Previously, Zhao Gongming and Guiling Holy Mother both won an innate spiritual treasure and gave it to their junior brother. Duobao was a little worried that his junior brother would be abducted!
Now it's finally his turn to play. No matter what innate spiritual treasures the opponent has in this round, they all have to be handed over to my junior brother!
Taoist Duobao came directly to that space and stood still, and then a nine-story crystal pagoda appeared in his hand!
"Jie Jiao Duobao Taoist, carry the Duobao Pagoda out of the station!"
A stream of light flashed past, and the crystal pagoda in his hand had fallen into the space!
Above the main hall, Yuanshi Tianzun showed a look of doubt. He had seen the Duobao Pagoda at Fenbao Cliff, but now it seems that the aura is a little different!
But seeing Chi Jingjing stand up confidently, Yuanshi Tianzun breathed a sigh of relief!
So what if the multi-treasure towers become a little stronger, they will still lose against the spiritual treasures in the hands of the red sperm.
Just in time to go back and study it with the Duobao Pagoda to see what the secrets of this third brother's weapon refining techniques are!
Seeing Taoist Duobao taking the lead in the battle, he also showed his battle against Lingbao Duobao Pagoda!
Red sperm suddenly became energetic and energetic.Stride to the center!
"Senior Brother Duobao, please teach me!"
He raised his palm gently, and a small yellow flag about two feet long appeared slowly!
